input_format: raw, one contiguous PROXY protocol candidate header
configuration_profile: standalone core parser with a real nginx pool and suppressed expected-rejection logging
justification: NGX-OSS-HTTP measured 0/76 scoped lines because its embedded listener does not enable proxy_protocol.
state: A fresh connection and nginx pool are created and destroyed for every input; no state crosses testcases.
known_limitations: The function contract takes one contiguous header; fragmentation is intentionally not invented.
This target checks parser memory safety and return bounds, not listener integration or post-parse variable lookup.
Only ngx_proxy_protocol_read is in the frozen percentage scope; helper execution remains visible in file coverage.

scopes.contract: Returns the first byte after one complete v1/v2 header, or NULL on rejection, and stores parsed metadata on the connection.
scopes.preconditions: Connection log and pool are valid; buf..last is contiguous and bounded.
